home.title: Welcome to Devpuri Farms
home.subtitle: Cultivating a sustainable future for our community and the planet.

organic.title: Organic Practices
organic.description: 100% chemical-free farming. We believe in working with nature, not against it. Our commitment to organic methods ensures the healthiest produce for your family.

community.title: Community Focused
community.description: Bringing fresh, local produce directly to your table through our CSA program. Supporting local farmers means supporting sustainable agriculture in your region.

sustainable.title: Sustainable Future
sustainable.description: Using solar power and regenerative agriculture to protect our land for generations. Every harvest strengthens our soil and protects our environment.

about.title: About Devpuri Farms
about.story: Founded in 2010, Devpuri Farms has been dedicated to bringing the freshest, most nutritious produce to our local community.
about.journey: Our story began with a small patch of land and a big dream: to farm in a way that heals the earth rather than harms it.
about.missionText: To provide sustainable food security for our region while practicing regenerative agriculture that restores soil health.

regenerative.title: Regenerative Agriculture
regenerative.description: We use cover crops and no-till farming to keep carbon in the soil and improve water retention.

water.title: Water Conservation
water.description: Our drip irrigation systems ensure that every drop of water is used efficiently, minimizing waste.

pest.title: Natural Pest Control
pest.description: Instead of harsh chemicals, we rely on beneficial insects and companion planting to keep pests at bay.

produce.title: Our Fresh Produce
produce.subtitle: Harvested daily, straight from our fields to your kitchen.
